title: tree-keeper's in
description: What the main conversation gives the tree-keeper: its Cut as it starts, and each change to write as it resumes it. tree.py's code gives the Cut, through the adapter of a start's text, and the guard limits the tree-keeper's calls to its run values.

start.description: The Cut, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the tree-keeper.

record.description: The path of the start's record, a file in the run's records/ that the role writes only by record.py, in the form of record.schema.json, and that rn's check reads at the role's end.

tree.description: The path of the run's design-tree.json, which the tree-keeper writes only by tree.py write.

best_practice.description: The folder of the design tree best practice, by which it checks each node it touches.

resume.description: The message by which the main conversation resumes the role with SendMessage: its first line, then its decision on the role's last result and why, and, where the person answered, a line that opens the person's words as they wrote them, as a summary loses what the person meant. After the grounds, a line `The change:` opens the change to write, as one JSON object in the form that tree.py write takes: each node by its path, such as the goal drafted, the plan, a Decision with its ground, or a Deliverable signed off, and each More to keep.
